scope: Stage C task reward capture version and checkpoint restore boundary

previous_version.source: ROUND32 frozen Stage C trainer and ROUND32 checkpoints; original artifacts preserved

restore_policy.resume_behavior: Rejects missing or different training_version/reward_timing_version before controller construction, optimizer construction/state restore, or RNG restore.
restore_policy.old_checkpoint_resume: refused; no silent continuation under corrected task credit
restore_policy.read_only_label: Returned identity states load_mode=read_only and labels missing reward_timing_version as legacy_unversioned_capture_semantics.
restore_policy.freeze_requirement: Read-only caller must supply the checkpoint's recorded freeze identity from its archived manifest.

historical_interpretation.past_task_counts_bytes_actions_and_model: remain observations of the executed ROUND32 trajectories
historical_interpretation.past_training_reward_contract: limited by one-tick-late capture relative to published completion events
historical_interpretation.round32_reduction_comparison: measured under the legacy reward-capture semantics and must not be directly generalized to training under the corrected version
historical_interpretation.causal_scope: The capture offset does not, by itself, explain all learning failures or establish a corrected-version policy outcome.

version_boundary_tests.legacy_resume_rejection: passed through v2_trainer.load_checkpoint with mocked torch.load; no controller/optimizer/RNG restore and no optimizer.step
version_boundary_tests.legacy_read_only_label: passed through v2_trainer.load_checkpoint_read_only with mocked payload/controller; optimizer/RNG untouched
